name: PyTorch 入门
description: PyTorch 框架入门，题目按学习顺序排列，取材自官方教程（Get Started / Learn the Basics / Beginner 60 分钟速览）与高星社区教程（Dive into Deep Learning、learn-pytorch 等）：先张量的形状、索引、步幅与视图/复制判定、广播与类型提升（dtype）账，再 autograd 求导与自定义 autograd.Function、前向/反向 Hook，然后组装 nn.Module、准备 Dataset 与 DataLoader、跑通 SGD 训练循环，最后处理 train/eval 模式、LR 调度器在循环里的位置、autocast 与 GradScaler、DistributedSampler 的单机索引账、参数冻结与优化器分组、state_dict 键重映射与断点续训。 nn.init 的 fan/gain/std/bound 记账：fan 的 receptive field 连乘、gain 查表与 bool param 拒收、kaiming 负斜率缺省 0 与 gain 缺省 0.01 的分流、xavier 的 fi+fo 分母，噪声显式入参的线性缩放壳。 DataLoader 单进程装配账：Sequential/Random/Batch 三层切批、DataLoader 每 epoch 的 _base_seed 抽取与 RandomSampler 无条件余数空消耗 quirk、有放回 32 分块、bool num_samples 放行、len 的 floor/ceil 双口径。 weights_only 白名单判定与 state_dict 键级账：zip 容器 data.pkl 的 GLOBAL 指令扫描、protocol-2 允许键表（含 range→xrange 拒绝 quirk 与 lambda 的 save 阶段 PicklingError）、2.6 起默认 True、load_state_dict 的 sorted missing/unexpected 差集。 RNG 可复现账：seed 的无符号 mod 2**64 包装与类型/越界双异常分类、fresh Generator 的 MT19937 缺省种子常数、get_state/set_state 的中流恢复与手写 fork 语义、dtype 进入消费路径与四原语顺序敏感消耗。
description_en: Introductory PyTorch, ordered as a learning path and drawn from the official tutorials (Get Started / Learn the Basics / Beginner 60-minute blitz) and high-star community tutorials (Dive into Deep Learning, learn-pytorch and similar): tensor shapes, indexing, the stride and view-or-copy layout ledger, broadcasting and the dtype type-promotion ledger first, then autograd, custom autograd.Function classes and forward/backward hooks, then assembling an nn.Module, preparing a Dataset and DataLoader and running an SGD training loop, and finally train/eval mode, where the LR scheduler belongs in the loop, autocast with GradScaler, the single-process index arithmetic of DistributedSampler, freezing parameters and optimizer groups, state_dict key remapping and resuming from a checkpoint. The nn.init fan/gain/std/bound ledger: receptive-field product in fan computation, the gain table with bool-param rejection, kaiming's negative-slope default of 0 versus gain's own 0.01 default, xavier's fi+fo denominator, and the explicit-noise linear-scaling shell. The single-process DataLoader assembly ledger: the Sequential/Random/Batch three-layer slicing, the per-epoch _base_seed draw plus RandomSampler's unconditional empty remainder draw quirk, the 32-block with-replacement path, bool num_samples being allowed, and the floor/ceil dual len semantics. The weights_only allowlist decision and state_dict key ledger: GLOBAL instruction scanning from the zip's data.pkl, the protocol-2 allowlist table (with the range→xrange rejection quirk and lambda's save-time PicklingError), the 2.6 default-to-True change, and load_state_dict's sorted missing/unexpected diffs. The RNG reproducibility ledger: unsigned mod-2**64 seed wrapping with dual error classification, the fresh generator's MT19937 default seed constant, mid-stream get_state/set_state restoration with hand-written fork semantics, dtype entering the consumption path, and order-sensitive four-primitive draining.

name: 算子合集
description: 手写神经网络核心算子：激活与归一化、卷积/池化/采样、注意力与位置编码、索引与形状变换、损失函数、优化器单步更新，以及 einsum、范数、logsumexp 等张量原语。
description_en: Hand-written neural network operators: activations and normalization, convolution/pooling/sampling, attention and positional encodings, indexing and shape transforms, loss functions, single optimizer steps, and tensor primitives such as einsum, norms and logsumexp.

name: AI 系统性能合集
description: 训练与推理系统的性能和显存账：激活/参数/KV Cache 显存估算、FLOPs 与 MFU、Roofline 与算术强度、算子融合的带宽收益、通信量与吞吐，以及缓存分配器、激活复用偏移规划和 offload 预取时间线等内存侧账本。
description_en: Performance and GPU-memory accounting for training and inference systems: activation/parameter/KV-cache estimates, FLOPs and MFU, Roofline and arithmetic intensity, the bandwidth win from operator fusion, communication volume and throughput, plus memory-side ledgers for the caching allocator, activation-reuse offset planning and offload prefetch timelines.

name: 分布式训练原语合集
description: 集合通信与多维并行：Broadcast / Gather / Scatter / All-Gather / Reduce-Scatter / All-Reduce / All-to-All / Reduce 与 Ring All-Reduce 逐步模拟，以及数据、张量、序列、专家、流水线并行的显存与通信账 —— ZeRO 分片与卸载、GPipe 气泡与 1F1B、Megatron TP、FSDP/DDP、rank 网格与通信组、弹性重映射、检查点与 Ring Attention。
description_en: Collective communication and multi-dimensional parallelism: Broadcast / Gather / Scatter / All-Gather / Reduce-Scatter / All-Reduce / All-to-All / Reduce with step-by-step Ring All-Reduce, plus the memory and communication accounting of data, tensor, sequence, expert and pipeline parallelism — ZeRO sharding and offload, GPipe bubble and 1F1B, Megatron TP, FSDP/DDP, rank grids and process groups, elastic remapping, checkpointing and Ring Attention.

name: 大模型结构合集
description: 大模型的构件与整模型装配：RMSNorm、RoPE、SwiGLU、GQA 因果注意力与 Decoder Layer，Qwen2 / Gemma2 全模型，DeepSeek MLA 及权重吸收后的解码，MTP 多 token 预测、YaRN/LongRoPE 长度外推、滑动窗口与全局掩码、softmax sink、Mixture-of-Depths、Squared-ReLU 注意力。
description_en: Building blocks and full-model assembly of modern LLMs: RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GQA causal attention and the decoder layer, complete Qwen2 / Gemma2 models, DeepSeek MLA and weight-absorbed latent attention, MTP multi-token prediction, YaRN/LongRoPE length extrapolation, sliding-window vs global masking, attention sinks, Mixture-of-Depths and Squared-ReLU attention.

name: 优化器与调度合集
description: 优化器与学习率调度的单步账本：AdamW 与各类 Adam 变体（Lion、Adafactor、Muon、AdaBelief、RAdam、AdaBound、AdamP、NovoGrad、Yogi、Tiger、ADOPT、Cautious、Prodigy、Sophia-II、GaLore、MARS、AdaMuon、Lookahead 等）、梯度累积与裁剪、EMA，以及 warmup-cosine、WSD、OneCycle、ReduceLROnPlateau、SGDR、Noam 等调度器。
description_en: Single-step accounting for optimizers and learning-rate schedules: AdamW and its variants (Lion, Adafactor, Muon, AdaBelief, RAdam, AdaBound, AdamP, NovoGrad, Yogi, Tiger, ADOPT, Cautious, Prodigy, Sophia-II, GaLore, MARS, AdaMuon, Lookahead and friends), gradient accumulation, clipping and EMA, plus schedulers such as warmup-cosine, WSD, OneCycle, ReduceLROnPlateau, SGDR and inverse-sqrt Noam.

name: 分词与数据整理合集
description: 分词与训练数据整理：BPE 合并规则的训练与编码、Unigram Viterbi 切分与路径采样、GPT-2 字节级预分词、WordPiece、特殊/Added token 模板与 ChatML 角色边界、UTF-8 偏移对齐与预算截断，以及批 Padding 与 attention_mask、序列打包、SFT 标签移位与逐轮损失权重、数据分片、近重复去重与文档内重复过滤和多数据集混采配额。
description_en: Tokenization and training-data preparation: training and applying BPE merges, Unigram Viterbi segmentation and path sampling, GPT-2 byte-level pre-tokenization, WordPiece, special/added-token templates and ChatML role boundaries, UTF-8 offset alignment and budgeted truncation, plus batch padding with attention_mask, sequence packing, SFT label shifting and per-turn loss weights, data sharding, near-duplicate dedup, intra-document repetition filtering and multi-dataset blending quotas.

name: 量化与低精度合集
description: 低精度量化与量化推理：对称/非对称、按通道/分组的 fake-quant 与 INT8 / FP8 / NF4 往返、Weight-Only GEMM，SmoothQuant、AWQ、LLM.int8()、QuaRot、GPTQ、SpQR、HQQ、BitNet、MX/BlockFP 等主流方案，以及离群值处理、误差补偿与缩放因子的搜索、位打包布局解包、KV Cache 量化，和部分二值化（PB-LLM）、格点量化（QuIP#）、按损失分配位宽（BAQ）、通道重排与分组（RPTQ / DuQuant）、双侧浮点 scale（AFPQ）与结构化残差二值（BiLLM）等低比特前沿方案。
description_en: Low-bit quantization and quantized inference: symmetric/asymmetric, per-channel and group-wise fake-quant with INT8 / FP8 / NF4 round-trips, weight-only GEMM, and mainstream schemes such as SmoothQuant, AWQ, LLM.int8(), QuaRot, GPTQ, SpQR, HQQ, BitNet and MX/BlockFP — plus outlier handling, error-compensation and scale searches, bit-packing layouts and unpacking, KV-cache quantization, and low-bit frontier schemes such as partial binarization (PB-LLM), lattice quantization (QuIP#), loss-driven bit allocation (BAQ), channel reordering and grouping (RPTQ / DuQuant), two-sided floating-point scales (AFPQ), and structural residual binarization (BiLLM).

name: 采样策略合集
description: 解码期的 logits 后处理与采样：Top-k / Top-p / Min-p / Typical / Top-n-sigma / P-less / Epsilon / Adaptive-p / DRY / Mirostat v2 / XTC / Dripping，重复惩罚与 logit 偏置、对比搜索、多路分布混合，以及 llama.cpp 的完整采样管线阶段顺序。
description_en: Logit post-processing and sampling at decode time: Top-k / Top-p / Min-p / Typical / Top-n-sigma / P-less / Epsilon / Adaptive-p / DRY / Mirostat v2 / XTC / Dripping, repetition penalties and logit bias, contrastive search, mixture-of-samplers, and the full stage order of the llama.cpp sampling pipeline.

name: MoE 路由与专家并行合集
description: 混合专家的路由与执行：Top-k、Expert-Choice、Aux-free、Sinkhorn 等门控，Switch/CV/z-loss/序列级负载均衡损失，容量分派与 token dropping、共享专家与路由专家合成、负载 EMA 与死专家账，专家隐藏激活 dropout（激活后、第二投影前，inverted scaling、训练/推理不对称），以及 all-to-all 分派合并、分组矩阵乘的排序计划与 offsets 切分。
description_en: Routing and execution in mixture-of-experts: top-k, expert-choice, aux-free and Sinkhorn gating, Switch/CV/z-loss/sequence-level load-balancing losses, capacity dispatch with token dropping, shared versus routed expert mixing, load EMA and dead-expert accounting, expert-hidden dropout (after the activation, before the second projection, inverted scaling with train/inference asymmetry), plus all-to-all dispatch/combine and the sorted plan and offset slicing of grouped expert matmuls.

name: LLM 推理 Serving 合集
description: LLM 服务侧的调度与显存账：Continuous Batching 与 chunked prefill、PagedAttention 块分配与页表写时复制、前缀/KV Cache 命中与 LRU 驱逐、请求准入与抢占、SLO/EDF 与每步 token 预算、推测解码的名额分配、beam search 与受限解码（DFA 掩码、前缀 trie 增量复用、token 级索引编译与 NSA 分支调度）、multi-LoRA 热切换、cache-aware 粘性路由、TTFT/TPOT 时间线与 PD 分离的搬运账。
description_en: Scheduling and memory accounting on the LLM serving side: continuous batching and chunked prefill, PagedAttention block allocation with page-table copy-on-write, prefix/KV-cache hits and LRU eviction, request admission and preemption, SLO/EDF and per-step token budgets, speculative-decoding token quotas, beam search and constrained decoding (DFA masks, prefix-trie incremental reuse, token-level index compilation and NSA branch dispatch), multi-LoRA hot-swapping, cache-aware sticky routing, TTFT/TPOT timelines and the transfer ledger of prefill/decode disaggregation.

name: KV Cache 压缩合集
description: 推理 KV Cache 的压缩与驱逐：注意力打分（StreamingLLM sink、H2O、SnapKV、AdaKV、Observed/ExpectedAttention、FINCH、Q-Filter、R-KV、TriAttention、Q-Trust）、保留预算分配（PyramidKV、CAKE、层间背包、Palu 秩预算、Quest 页级选择、KVzip 全局阈值）、值合并与重旋转（WKVD、ZSMerge、HOMER、MorphKV、LoCoCo、KeyRerotation），以及稀疏模式搜索、低秩共享、张量积分解（TPA）与文档分段复用（KVLink）等通道/层/序列维度的策略。
description_en: Compression and eviction for the inference KV cache: attention-based scoring (StreamingLLM sinks, H2O, SnapKV, AdaKV, Observed/ExpectedAttention, FINCH, Q-Filter, R-KV, TriAttention, Q-Trust), retention-budget allocation (PyramidKV, CAKE, per-layer knapsacks, Palu rank budgets, Quest page selection, KVzip global thresholds), value merging and re-rotation (WKVD, ZSMerge, HOMER, MorphKV, LoCoCo, KeyRerotation), plus sparse-pattern search, low-rank sharing, tensor-product factorization (TPA), and document-segment reuse (KVLink) across channel/layer/sequence dimensions.

name: 对齐与训练目标合集
description: 对齐与后训练的目标函数：DPO / IPO / cDPO / ORPO / SimPO 等偏好损失与 DPO 的解析反向，PPO 与 GRPO 的截断代理目标、价值损失和自适应 KL 控制器，DAPO / GSPO / CISPO / RLOO / Dr.GRPO / REINFORCE++ 的优势估计与归一化次序，KTO、Bradley-Terry 奖励模型损失、GAE、label smoothing，以及 GKD / MiniLM 蒸馏。
description_en: Objective functions for alignment and post-training: preference losses such as DPO / IPO / cDPO / ORPO / SimPO with the analytic backward of DPO, the clipped surrogate, value loss and adaptive KL controller of PPO and GRPO, the advantage estimators and normalization order of DAPO / GSPO / CISPO / RLOO / Dr.GRPO / REINFORCE++, KTO, the Bradley-Terry reward-model loss, GAE and label smoothing, plus GKD / MiniLM distillation.

name: 推测解码合集
description: 推测解码的草稿生成与验证：Medusa 多头候选树、Sequoia 多分支采样与最优草稿树 DP、EAGLE-2 动态重排与剪枝、SpecInfer 通用 token-tree 并行验证、LayerSkip 逐层早退，typical acceptance 与逐 token 接受判据、Lookahead Jacobi n-gram 与 REST/后缀自动机草稿、tree attention 掩码构造，以及接受率到加速比的解析账。
description_en: Draft generation and verification in speculative decoding: Medusa multi-head candidate trees, Sequoia multi-branch sampling and optimal draft-tree DP, EAGLE-2 dynamic re-ranking and pruning, SpecInfer generic token-tree parallel verification, LayerSkip early-exit drafts, typical acceptance and per-token acceptance tests, Lookahead Jacobi n-grams and REST/suffix-automaton drafting, tree-attention mask construction, and the analytic acceptance-rate-to-speedup ledger.

name: 参数高效微调合集
description: 参数高效微调的旁路模块：LoRA 前向、权重合并与参数量账，IA³、Adapter、DoRA、BitFit、Prompt/Prefix-Tuning，LoHa / LoKr / AdaLoRA / VeRA / UniLoRA / VB-LoRA / C3A / WaveFT / FourierFT 等重参数化，OFT / BOFT / HRA / RoAD 等正交与旋转适配，DARE+TIES 合并与 GLoRA 逆解，以及 QLoRA、多 Adapter 热切换与 Adapter 池共享。
description_en: Bypass modules for parameter-efficient fine-tuning: LoRA forward, weight merging and parameter counts, IA³, adapters, DoRA, BitFit and prompt/prefix tuning, re-parameterizations such as LoHa / LoKr / AdaLoRA / VeRA / UniLoRA / VB-LoRA / C3A / WaveFT / FourierFT, orthogonal and rotation adapters like OFT / BOFT / HRA / RoAD, DARE+TIES merging and the exact GLoRA inverse, plus QLoRA, multi-adapter hot swapping and shared adapter pools.

name: 扩散模型合集
description: 扩散与流匹配模型的采样与训练基建：正弦时间步嵌入与线性/余弦噪声调度，DDPM 前向加噪与反向后验，DDIM 及其逆向一步，ε / x₀ / v 预测互转，Euler / DPM-Solver(++) / UniPC / LCM / EDM 预条件 / Flow Matching 等求解器，CFG 与 APG / TCFG / PAG / FDG / AutoGuidance 等引导算子，zero-terminal-SNR、Min-SNR、SD3 时间步密度与分辨率分桶等训练侧，以及 RePaint / SDEdit / 熵界 / AMUS / VQ-Diffusion / BlockRefinement 等掩码与离散扩散调度。
description_en: The sampling and training infrastructure of diffusion and flow-matching models: sinusoidal timestep embeddings and linear/cosine noise schedules, DDPM forward noising and reverse posterior steps, DDIM and its inverse, conversions between ε / x₀ / v predictions, solvers such as Euler / DPM-Solver(++) / UniPC / LCM / EDM preconditioning / Flow Matching, CFG and guidance operators like APG / TCFG / PAG / FDG / AutoGuidance, training-side pieces such as zero-terminal-SNR, Min-SNR, SD3 timestep densities and resolution bucketing, and masked or discrete schedulers such as RePaint / SDEdit / entropy-bound / AMUS / VQ-Diffusion / BlockRefinement.

name: 稀疏剪枝合集
description: 模型压缩中的剪枝与稀疏存储：全局与逐行幅值剪枝、2:4 及 N:M 半结构化剪枝、块结构与注意力头剪枝，Wanda / OWL / TRIM / SparseGPT 等打分与误差补偿，GSL 渐稀疏调度和动态稀疏训练的 drop–grow 与 STE 微调，以及 CSR / ELL / BSR 编码、元数据打包与存储字节账。
description_en: Pruning and sparse storage in model compression: global and per-row magnitude pruning, 2:4 and N:M semi-structured pruning, block-structured and attention-head pruning, scoring with error compensation as in Wanda / OWL / TRIM / SparseGPT, gradual sparsity schedules and dynamic-sparsity drop-grow with STE fine-tuning, plus CSR / ELL / BSR encodings, metadata packing and storage byte ledgers.

name: 多模态合集
description: 视觉-语言模型的几何重排与对齐训练：ViT patchify 与 Swin 窗口划分，Qwen2-VL 的 smart resize、2×2 patch merge 与 M-RoPE 位置编号，CLIP InfoNCE 与 SigLIP 对比损失，位置嵌入重采样、视频时空 patch 顺序、图像占位展开与混合 batch 整理、Perceiver latent 压缩、Flamingo 门控融合、SAM 提示嵌入与掩码选择、FastV / LLaVA-PruMerge 视觉 token 剪枝与合并（含 IQR 自适应保留数）、Qwen2.5-VL 窗口注意力的重排索引与 cu 窗口边界账、完整 M-RoPE 索引（视频时间轴与交错分段），、FLUX 二维 RoPE 与 single-stream 拼流装配（vec 加法、文本流在前、3 参数调制）。
description_en: Geometric rearrangement and contrastive training in vision-language models: ViT patchify and Swin window partition, Qwen2-VL smart resize / 2x2 patch merge / M-RoPE position ids, CLIP InfoNCE and SigLIP losses, positional-embedding resampling, video spatio-temporal patch order, image placeholder expansion and mixed batch collation, Perceiver latent compression, Flamingo gated fusion, SAM prompt embeddings and mask selection, FastV / LLaVA-PruMerge visual-token pruning and merging (including the IQR-adaptive kept count), Qwen2.5-VL windowed-attention reorder index and cu-window boundary ledger, the full M-RoPE index (video temporal axis and interleaved segmentation), , FLUX 2D RoPE and the single-stream assembly (additive vec, text-first concat, 3-parameter modulation).

name: 语音前端合集
description: 语音模型前端的确定性信号处理：预加重与分帧加窗、STFT 幅度谱（n_fft / hop / center 与反射填充）、Mel 滤波器组与 log-mel（HTK / Slaney 刻度）、MFCC（正交 DCT-II + lifter + CMVN），以及整数比多相重采样。
description_en: Deterministic speech front-ends: pre-emphasis with framing and windowing, STFT magnitude spectra (n_fft / hop / center with reflective padding), Mel filter banks and log-mel (HTK vs Slaney scales), MFCC (orthogonal DCT-II plus liftering and CMVN), and integer-ratio polyphase resampling.

name: 向量检索合集
description: 向量检索与 RAG 检索管线：IVF 粗量化分配与 nprobe 多探测归并、乘积量化编码与 ADC 打分、k-means Lloyd 迭代，HNSW 建图插入与贪心搜索，BM25、倒排 postings 与 Block-Max WAND、ColBERT MaxSim，RRF 融合与 MMR 重排，以及重叠滑窗、late chunking 与父子块扩展的分块策略。
description_en: Vector retrieval and the RAG pipeline: IVF coarse assignment with nprobe multi-probe merging, product quantization encoding and ADC scoring, k-means Lloyd iterations, HNSW insertion and greedy search, BM25, inverted postings with Block-Max WAND and ColBERT MaxSim, RRF fusion and MMR re-ranking, plus chunking strategies such as overlapping sliding windows, late chunking and parent-child block expansion.

name: LLM 评测指标合集
description: LLM 评测与数据卫生的确定性指标：困惑度与忽略位的 token 准确率、语料级 BLEU、ROUGE-1/2/L 与最长公共子序列、pass@k 无偏估计、nDCG@k 折损累积增益、few-shot 提示预算截断，shingle 污染审计，以及 LLM-as-judge pairwise 的 swap 两局位置偏差账与半胜聚合。 IF-Eval 结构判别器三类账：JSON 整体包裹的多级反引号剥除与标量/扩展解析口径、postscript 落款的三分支正则与 marker 不转义通配 quirk、双答案 6 星分隔的空段位置账。
description_en: Deterministic metrics for LLM evaluation and data hygiene: perplexity and token accuracy with ignored positions, corpus-level BLEU, ROUGE-1/2/L with LCS, the unbiased pass@k estimator, nDCG@k discounted cumulative gain, few-shot prompt budget truncation, and shingle-based contamination audits. plus the LLM-as-judge pairwise swap-two-game position-bias ledger with half-win aggregation. The IF-Eval structure-checker trio: whole-output JSON wrapping with multi-level backtick stripping and scalar/extension parsing rules, the postscript three-branch regex with the un-escaped-marker wildcard quirk, and the six-asterisk dual-response empty-segment position ledger.

name: RL 基建合集
description: 大模型强化学习训练栈的系统与数据流账：优先经验回放的采样与 IS 权重、rollout 跨 rank 重分片与 padding-free 打包、actor/critic/ref 多模型 colocate 的显存与阶段时间线、奖励归一化的批统计管道、异步 rollout 的准入与陈旧度，以及多段 episode 拼装与截断 bootstrap。
description_en: Systems and data-flow accounting in the RL training stack for LLMs: prioritized experience replay sampling with importance-sampling weights, cross-rank rollout resharding and padding-free packing, the memory and phase timeline when colocating actor/critic/reference models, batch statistics for reward normalization, admission and staleness in asynchronous rollouts, and multi-segment episode assembly with truncated bootstrapping.

name: 智能体系统合集
description:
LLM agent 运行时的编排逻辑：ReAct 循环状态机与终止/死循环护栏、工具调用参数的 JSON Schema 校验与归一、任务 DAG 的拓扑执行与加权关键路径，以及上下文窗口的优先级压缩与预算装填，以及生成式智能体的三因子记忆检索与工具调用循环熔断护栏。 Tree of Thoughts BFS 搜索过程账：propose 拼尾部换行与 sample 无分隔拼接、重复候选硬置 0（非缓存值）且评估文本被无视、game24 权重表 {impossible:0.001, likely:1, sure:20} 按评估文本末行精确匹配且不除以样本数、恰 4 行无 answer 惩罚（strip 后行数）、greedy 稳定降序平分保原下标序、本轮选择即下轮父节点。 ReWOO 占位符计划账：#Ed 证据号 len==3 单数字下标才有效（多位下标调用被丢弃记 No evidence found 且其字符串作为 pass-through 证据参与后续替换）、split('[',1) 后盲删末字符、占位符 replace 全量替换会命中插入文本新出现的引用、前向引用原样保留、worker_log 按 #E{i+1} 下标配对、LLM token len(调用串+证据)//4 与固定 davinci-003 工具价、Google 计次成本与模型价格表未知名报错。 MemoryBank 遗忘曲线账：官方 forgetting_curve=exp(-t/5*S) 优先级陷阱（exp(-t*S/5)，强度越大衰减越快，与论文意图相反）、draw>retention 严格大于恰等保留、遗忘下标逆序 pop、日期清空时 history 与 summary 同步删除（无 key 即崩）、无 history 键用户整体不进结果库、旧格式对话迁移写回、摘要永不遗忘且非 dict 包 content、检索强化按 id.split('_')[1] 定位日期只改首个匹配。 Graph of Thoughts 操作账：Thought setter 标志位（score/valid/solved setter 分别置 scored/validated/compared）、两种 thought 产地（from_thought 复制标志 vs Thought({**state,**update}) 全新缺省——score 复位 0.0）、Score combined 的 zip 截断、ValidateAndImprove 恒定无效恰 num_tries+1 次验证、Aggregate 按 score 升序 stable 合并且高者覆盖同名键（未打分缺省 0.0）、KeepBestN 平分保原序与 TypeError fallback 只留 isinstance(float)（int score 也被丢）、KeepValid 未验证放行、GroundTruth 裸 except 吞异常置 solved=False、零 thoughts 不报错仅首个操作无前驱才 ValueError。 LATS MCTS 搜索账：UCT visits==0 返回 value（官方注释掉 inf）与 sqrt(ln(parent.visits)/visits) 用各自父的 visits、max 平分取先扩展者、selection 恒下行到叶子故内层模拟只碰当轮新 child、循环变量泄漏/break 断点决定唯一得 reward 的 update 对象（同批其余零 update）、末轮对第一个 child 即 evaluate+break、reward_internal 按 Tested passed:/Tests failed: 拼写不一致的标记取非空行数归一、eval 失败也无条件 break、backprop 沿链到 root、gather_context 对选择端点收集并反转、终局 best_child_value 按累计 value（非均值）平分取先。 Reflexion 经验记忆账：EnvironmentHistory 构造期滑窗 [-3:] if len>3（官方是 3 条非 5）且 Trial 编号按截断后列表从头数、base query 双换行段头与 f'
Trial {i}:
{m.strip()}'、add 熔断是与最近一次不同 action 比较（隔 observation 的重复也触发、只置 True 永不清、重复分支不更新 _last_action 因粘滞不可观测）、reset 只清 history 不清熔断与 last_action、渲染 cur_query+'
' 打头且末条后无换行、trial log 按 '#####

#####' 切分后 part0 带头残段/末段带尾 ##### 与汇总行并全部流入 scenario、反思门 not is_success and not skip、反思结果追加完整 memory、反思 query 的记忆二次截断 [-3:]、反思 query 用 'Trial #{i}: {m}
'（带 #、不 strip）与 base query 两套格式并存、scenario 取 split('Here is the task:')[-1]（多次出现取末段并吃 STATUS/##### 尾巴）。 MemGPT 主上下文换页账：smart cutoff 从队尾反向逐条累加 tok(str(m))（整个 dict 的 repr，system 不豁免）且累加后 >= warning*0.2 才 break（跑满减到 -1 走负索引）、保尾 min(len-3, cutoff)、角色移位官方 bug（内层 'still user' 只打印 ignoring、cutoff=new_cutoff 在内层 if 之外移位无条件发生、仅 IndexError 才不动）、待摘切片 messages[1:cutoff]（system 按位置豁免、cutoff=0 空序列、-1 丢首尾）、递归摘要门严格大于（恰等不触发）与 ratio=(th/总量)*0.8、cut2=int(n*ratio) 向零截断、递归返回串与剩余 dict 混装 str()、hidden=all_time-remaining、system_alert json 打包（'
 {summary}' 带空格）、trim 保 system 后 prepend（cutoff=0 时 system 重复出现）、messages_total 摘要也算新增。 Toolformer 调用过滤账：位置采样 p>tau_s 严格门（恰等丢弃）+ top-k 降序稳定平分保原序 + 每位置前 m 个候选、加权 CE w̃_t=max(0,1-0.2t) 全局归一 /3.0（短后缀不重归一、t>=5 零权重占位）、L⁻=min(L(ε),L(e(c,ε))) 双对照取小、score=L⁻-L⁺ >= tau_f 含等门（浮点恰等被 (w̃/3)·lp 舍入吃掉的全 -1 后缀判丢 quirk）、文本级去重正则三 quirk（前导空格必须、工具名 \w+ 空名不匹配、args [^)]* 遇 ')' 截断）保第一个其余替换 ''、全体候选前置校验缺键/长度/坏 pos。 ToolLLM DFS 决策树账：进入即判 depth>=max_step/pruned/is_terminal（终局优先于深度、深度到顶即剪）、回溯倒计数（终局 2 / 放弃 2 / 普通剪枝 1 与 result-1 上卷）、DFSDT 生成即递归 vs normal DFS 攒够 tree_beam_size 个候选后双向对称两两比对（1 分/0.5 平分）再稳定降序展开、比对查询计入 query_count、票只看末字符（'A is better' 因末字符 'r' 判第一候选输）、展开循环 result>1 即 make_finish(2) 并放弃同层剩余候选（answer=n 也要跨层才凑满）、make_finish 递减含自身且 root 也是 Action Input（三层深链只标到第二个）、diversity 沿 children[0] 链取第一个 Action Input 且 compute_weight 恒 0.0、预算判定在建点前（超预算响应整个丢弃）与空响应在 Thought 上自递归烧预算、give up 随机挑选显式化为 seed。 Self-RAG 反思 token 打分账：检索门用原始 log-prob 相除（负数除法把方向翻过来——越不想检索越触发，exp 概率比才是论文口径）、门槛严格大于、threshold=None 退化为字符串子串判定且 mode 三态短路（always/no_retrieval 不看门）、ret_tokens 第三个 token 只算分不进比值、门里的 -100 兜底是死代码（随即下标取值 KeyError）、relevance/ground/utility 的缺失 token 兜底 exp(-100) 次正规数（两 rel 全缺恰 0.5）、ground 只读第一个 ground token 位置且 P(Fully)+0.5·P(Partially) 归一、utility 权重表 [-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1] 可出负分、use_groundness/use_utility 默认关、final=w_rel·rel+w_sup·ground+w_use·utility（+exp(seq) 可选）、no_retrieval 结果无 score 被两条聚合路径跳过而单结果分支返回第二次生成、closed 按答案文本累加合并、open 返回未 postprocess 原文、两套 postprocess 不对称（一个剥单前导空格一个删换行/endoftext）。 Search-R1 检索掩码账：多轮 `<search>/<information>` 交错序列的 rollout 记账——`</search>` 优先于 `</answer>` 且与位置无关地截断（先答后搜时动作是 answer，search 段却整段留在 policy token 里）、解析要开闭配对且内容取最近同名闭标签、skip_special_tokens 后重新 tokenize 让特殊 token 整段消失（连 token 位都不占）、非法动作照样吃掉一轮并塞入单空格连成的重试提示、观测按 `[:max_obs_length]` 截前缀（`</information>` 常被砍，重试提示同受上限）、训练侧 `[:max_len]` 前缀锚定（封顶后新 token 静默丢弃、动作照常生效）对上下文侧 `[-max_len:]` 后缀锚定（答案进了上下文却没进 loss）、prompt 端点 `[-max_start_length:]` 后缀截断且 0 因 `[-0:]` 等于全量、`max_prompt_length=0` 在两侧语义相反、final rollout 的 `do_search=False` 不追加观测、不更新 turns_stats、search 永不完成（turns 可到 max_turns+1）、turns_stats 恒等于该行生成次数、info_mask 在 prompt 与 policy 段为 1、观测段为 0。 MetaGPT 消息池路由账：两级 publish-subscribe 记账——环境层按角色 addresses（默认 `{类路径, 名字}`）做传输投递、`<all>` 由 `_publish_message` 在转换前加上，角色层再按 `cause_by in watch` 或「名字在收件人里」过滤；普通消息必 `send_to.add(tl.name)`（加的是名字、私聊下地址不含名字就收不到），转交判据却是 `publicer == tl.profile`；只有 `send_to` **整集合等于** `{"no one"}` 才丢（早退在 history 之前，既不投递也不记账）；直聊簿只收当前空转的收件人、回包按 `sent_from` 命中即消费、私聊下不发布但仍记 history；文本改写只留 system/user/assistant、`sent_from` 优先 `metadata["agent"]`、`send_to == {<all>}` 时显示团队负责人名字；history 按整条消息等值去重（每次成功发布进两条：改写件+原文），重复发不再涨但投递照旧；`_observe` 三道门（watch/收件人、不在记忆里）、`observe_all` 把整批 buffer 写进记忆、`enable_memory=False` 让第三道门失效、恢复口径从记忆捞锚点且捞到就不 drain buffer、`is_idle` 三要素导致「两轮才空转」。
description_en:
Runtime orchestration for LLM agents: the ReAct loop state machine with termination and loop-guard conditions, JSON Schema validation and normalization of tool-call arguments, topological execution of task DAGs with weighted critical paths, and priority-based context-window compaction under a token budget, plus the generative-agent three-factor memory retrieval and the tool-call loop-breaker guard. The Tree-of-Thoughts BFS search ledger: propose's trailing-newline concat versus sample's bare concat, repeated candidates hard-zeroed (not a cache hit) with eval texts ignored, the game24 weight table {impossible:0.001, likely:1, sure:20} matched on eval-text last lines without sample-count normalization, the exactly-4-lines-no-answer penalty on post-strip line counts, greedy stable descending ties keeping original index order, and each selection becoming the next step's parents. The ReWOO placeholder plan ledger: evidence ids valid only at len==3 (multi-digit calls discarded as No evidence found, whose literal string then passes through into later substitutions), the blind last-character trim after split('[',1), replace-all semantics hitting placeholders inside inserted evidence, forward references kept literal, worker_log pairing by the #E{i+1} index, LLM tokens as len(call+evidence)//4 with a fixed davinci-003 tool price, Google per-call cost, and the model price table raising on unknown names. The MemoryBank forgetting-curve ledger: the official forgetting_curve=exp(-t/5*S) precedence trap (exp(-t*S/5), stronger memories decay faster, opposite to the paper's intent), the strict draw>retention test where equality keeps, reverse-order pops of forgotten indices, emptied dates removed from history and summary together (missing keys crash), users without a history key dropped from the result bank entirely, legacy dialog migration written back, summaries never forgotten with non-dict values wrapped, and reinforcement locating the date via id.split('_')[1] while updating only the first match. The Graph-of-Thoughts operations ledger: Thought setter flags (score/valid/solved setters setting scored/validated/compared), two thought provenances (from_thought copying flags versus Thought({**state,**update}) brand-new defaults with score reset to 0.0), Score combined's zip truncation, ValidateAndImprove's exactly num_tries+1 validations when persistently invalid, Aggregate's ascending-score stable merge where higher scores override same-name keys (unscored defaulting to 0.0), KeepBestN's tie-keeping order and the TypeError fallback keeping only isinstance(float) (int scores dropped too), KeepValid passing unvalidated thoughts through, GroundTruth's bare except setting solved=False, and zero thoughts flowing silently with only the first operation's missing predecessor raising ValueError. The LATS MCTS search ledger: UCT's visits==0 returning value (inf commented out officially) with sqrt(ln(parent.visits)/visits) using each node's own parent's visits, max tie-breaking toward the first-extended child, selection always descending to a leaf so the inner simulation only touches the current batch, the leaked loop variable or break point deciding the sole rewarded update object (batch siblings get zero updates), the last iteration evaluating the first child and breaking, reward_internal counted from the inconsistently spelled Tested passed:/Tests failed: markers normalized by non-empty lines, unconditional break on failed evals, backprop chaining to the root, gather_context collecting at the selection endpoint reversed earliest-first, and the terminal best_child_value ranking by cumulative value (not the mean) with first-on-ties. The Reflexion episodic memory ledger: EnvironmentHistory's construction window [-3:] if len>3 (officially 3 entries, not 5) with Trial numbering restarted over the truncated list, the double-newline section header and f'
Trial {i}:
{m.strip()}', add's exhaustion comparing against the most recent distinct action (repeats across observations trigger, sticky True, the non-updated _last_action unobservable due to stickiness), reset clearing history only, rendering headed by cur_query+'
' with no trailing newline, the '#####

#####' split whose part0 leading residual and last-part trailing ##### plus summary lines all flow into the scenario, the reflection gate not is_success and not skip with results appended to the full memory, the reflection query's second [-3:] window, the hashed unstripped 'Trial #{i}: {m}
' format coexisting with the base query's format, and scenario extraction taking split('Here is the task:')[-1] (last segment on repeats, swallowing the STATUS/##### tail). The MemGPT main-context paging ledger: smart cutoff accumulating tok(str(m)) (the whole dict repr, system not exempt) from the tail with the break tested after accumulation at >= warning*0.2 (runs down to -1 with negative indexing), the keep-tail min(len-3, cutoff), the role-shift official bug (the inner 'still user' check only prints ignoring while cutoff=new_cutoff sits outside the inner if so the shift is unconditional, only IndexError keeps it), the slice messages[1:cutoff] (system exempt by position, cutoff=0 empty, -1 dropping both ends), the strictly-greater recursion gate (equality not triggering) with ratio=(th/total)*0.8 and cut2=int(n*ratio) truncating toward zero, the recursive string mixed with remaining dicts via str(), hidden=all_time-remaining, the system_alert json packaging (the space in '
 {summary}'), trim keeping the system message before prepending (cutoff=0 duplicates it), and the summary counting toward messages_total. The Toolformer call filtering ledger: position sampling with the strict p>tau_s gate (equality dropped) plus descending-stable top-k and the first-m cap per position, the weighted CE w̃_t=max(0,1-0.2t) globally normalized by 3.0 (no per-suffix re-normalization, t>=5 zero-weight slots), L⁻=min(L(ε),L(e(c,ε))) of the two controls, score=L⁻-L⁺ with the inclusive >= tau_f gate (the float quirk where the all -1 suffix's exact boundary is eaten by (w̃/3)·lp rounding and dropped), text-level dedup with the three regex quirks (mandatory leading space, \w+ tool names rejecting empty names, args [^)]* truncated at ')') keeping the first match and replacing the rest with '', and upfront validation of missing keys/lengths/bad positions over ALL candidates. ToolLLM DFS decision-tree ledger: the entry-time triple test depth>=max_step/pruned/is_terminal (terminal beats depth, the depth cap prunes), the backtrack countdown (2 for terminal, 2 for give-up, 1 for plain pruning, unwound as result-1), DFSDT recursing on generation versus normal DFS collecting tree_beam_size candidates and ranking them with symmetric both-direction pairwise comparisons (1 point to the winner, 0.5 each on a tie) before expanding in stable descending order, comparison queries counting toward query_count, votes decided by the last character only ('A is better' loses because it ends in 'r'), the expansion loop calling make_finish(2) and dropping the remaining siblings as soon as result>1 (so answer=n needs different levels to fill), make_finish decrementing on itself with the root also an Action Input (a three-step chain stops at the second), diversity walking the children[0] chain to the first Action Input with compute_weight pinned at 0.0, the budget checked before node creation (an over-budget response is discarded whole) with a null response on a Thought self-recursing until the budget dies, and give-up selection exposed as a seed. Self-RAG reflection-token scoring ledger: the retrieval gate divides raw log-probs (dividing negatives flips the direction, so the less it wants to retrieve the more it triggers; the exp-ed probability ratio is what the paper intends), the strictly-greater threshold, threshold=None degrading to a substring test with the three-way mode short-circuit (always_retrieve/no_retrieval bypass the gate), the third ret_token being scored but absent from the ratio, the dead -100 fallback in the gate (the next line indexes anyway and raises KeyError), the exp(-100) subnormal fallback for missing relevance/ground/utility tokens (exactly 0.5 when both relevance tokens are missing), ground reading only the first ground-token position with P(Fully)+0.5·P(Partially) normalization, the utility weight table [-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1] that can go negative, use_groundness/use_utility defaulting off, final=w_rel·rel+w_sup·ground+w_use·utility (+exp(seq) optional), the score-less no_retrieval result skipped by both aggregation paths while the single-result branch returns the second generation, closed aggregation summing by answer text, the open path returning raw un-postprocessed text, and the asymmetric postprocessors (one strips a single leading space, the other removes newlines and endoftext). Search-R1 retrieval mask ledger: rollout bookkeeping over interleaved `<search>/<information>` sequences — `</search>` truncation that beats `</answer>` regardless of position (an answer-then-search generation keeps the search span among the policy tokens while the action is answer), pair-required parsing that takes the nearest same-kind closer, skip_special_tokens plus re-tokenization dropping special tokens entirely (not even a token slot), an invalid action still burning a turn with the single-space retry prompt, observations clipped from the front by `[:max_obs_length]` (losing `</information>`, retry prompt subject to the same cap), a prefix-anchored training side (`[:max_len]`, new tokens silently dropped once full while the action still takes effect) against a suffix-anchored context (`[-max_len:]`, so the answer reaches the context but never the loss), prompt tail truncation via `[-max_start_length:]` where 0 means everything because of `[-0:]`, `max_prompt_length=0` meaning opposite things on the two sides, the `do_search=False` final rollout appending no observation, leaving turns_stats untouched and never completing a search (turns may reach max_turns+1), turns_stats always equal to the row's generation count, and info_mask 1 over prompt and policy with 0 over observation. MetaGPT message-pool routing ledger: two-level publish-subscribe bookkeeping — the environment delivers by each role's addresses (default `{class path, name}`) with `<all>` added by `_publish_message` before conversion, and the role then filters by `cause_by in watch` or "my name is among the recipients"; a regular message always does `send_to.add(tl.name)` (the name, so a private-mode leader without that address never receives it) while the takeover predicate is `publicer == tl.profile`; only an exactly equal `send_to == {"no one"}` is dropped (the early return precedes history, so nothing is delivered or recorded); the direct-chat ledger only admits currently idle recipients, consumes the flag as soon as `sent_from` matches, and in private mode publishes nothing while still recording history; text rewriting keeps only system/user/assistant, prefers `metadata["agent"]` for the sender, and displays the team leader's name when `send_to == {<all>}`; history dedups whole messages (two entries per successful publish: the rewritten copy and the original), so a repeated publish adds nothing while delivery still happens; `_observe` has three gates (watch/recipient and not-already-in-memory), `observe_all` writes the whole buffer batch to memory, `enable_memory=False` disables the third gate, recovery pulls the anchor from memory and skips draining the buffer when it hits, and the three-part `is_idle` means two rounds are needed before everyone idles.

name: 视觉检测合集
description: 检测与分割流水线的基础算子与账本：anchor 生成与 IoU 阈值匹配、FCOS center-ness 与多尺度层分配、WBF 加权框融合、mAP 的 11-point / all-point / COCO 三种口径、COCO RLE 编解码与 mask IoU、FPN 融合与层尺寸账，以及旋转框 NMS 与可变形采样偏移聚合、YOLOv1 无 anchor 网格责任编码（截断重算 + sqrt 编码 + 先到先得仲裁）与平移/平方互逆 decode、YOLOv3 anchor 系 best-anchor 匹配与 xy 线性偏移 / wh log-exp 互逆的编解码账、SPP-Net 金字塔池化的 caffe kernel/pad 划分账（重叠窗口与空 bin quirk）、YOLOv4 Mosaic 四象限拼接的 truth 平移/收缩修正/终门与 copy_plan 账、KL-Loss variance voting 的槽位序贪心 + 逐坐标方差加权融合账（+1 约定 IoU、thresh 钳制、任何正重叠衰减、tail-swap 移除）、YOLOX SimOTA 的几何粗筛（1.5·stride 邻域）+ cost 三项 + dynamic-k（int 截断）与冲突仲裁账、YOLOv5 build_targets 的 wh 双向比粗筛（格宽/像素 anchor 混搭）+ 五方向 0.5 偏移双门扩展 + 截断格点账、YOLOv8 TAL 的对齐分（类分^α·CIoU^β）top-k + overlap 仲裁 + 软标签归一（eps 淹没效应）账。
description_en: Foundational operators and ledgers in detection and segmentation pipelines: anchor generation with IoU-threshold matching, FCOS center-ness and multi-scale level assignment, weighted box fusion, mAP under the 11-point, all-point and COCO conventions, COCO RLE encoding/decoding and mask IoU, FPN top-down fusion with layer size accounting, plus rotated-box NMS and deformable sampling-offset aggregation, YOLOv1 anchor-free grid-responsibility encoding (post-clamp recomputation, sqrt encoding, first-come-first-served arbitration) with its translate/square inverse decode, and YOLOv3 best-anchor matching with the linear-offset-xy / log-exp-wh encode-decode ledger, and the SPP-Net pyramid pooling caffe kernel/pad windowing ledger (overlapping windows and the empty-bin quirk), and the YOLOv4 Mosaic quadrant-blend truth ledger (quadrant shifts, shrink corrections, final gate, copy_plan), and the KL-Loss variance-voting ledger (slot-order greedy + per-coordinate sigma-weighted fusion, +1-convention IoU, thresh clamp, any-positive-overlap decay, tail-swap removal), and the YOLOX SimOTA ledger (1.5·stride neighborhood pre-filter, triple cost, int-truncated dynamic-k, conflict arbitration), and the YOLOv5 build_targets ledger (two-sided wh-ratio pre-filter with the grid/pixel mixup, five-direction dual-gate 0.5-offset expansion, truncated grid cells), and the YOLOv8 TAL ledger (align = score^alpha * CIoU^beta top-k, overlap arbitration, soft-label normalization with the eps-swallowing effect).

name: 自动微分反向合集
description: 反向传播的逐算子账本：softmax 与交叉熵（label smoothing / ignore_index）、linear/matmul 的 dX 与 dW，LayerNorm / RMSNorm / BatchNorm 训练态，注意力与 FlashAttention 反向、GQA 折头求和，Embedding 重复 id 累加，conv2d 与池化的路由分摊，LSTM 沿时间累加与截断 BPTT，激活与 Dropout、weight_norm 重参数化的逐元素反向，以及用中心差分校验自定义 autograd.Function。
description_en: Per-operator backward ledgers: softmax and cross-entropy (label smoothing / ignore_index) and dX/dW for linear/matmul, LayerNorm / RMSNorm / training-mode BatchNorm, attention and FlashAttention backward with GQA head folding, Embedding duplicate-id accumulation, conv2d and pooling routing, LSTM accumulation over time with truncated BPTT, elementwise backward for activations, dropout and weight_norm re-parameterization, and custom autograd.Function checks against central differences.

name: 数值稳定合集
description: 浮点与归约的数值稳定性：补偿求和与成对求和、Welford 在线均值方差、跳 NaN 归约的计数与哨兵语义、bfloat16 舍入与 FP8 分块缩放、随机舍入的无偏与偏置方向、分块 online softmax 只交换 (max, sum) 的重标定合并，以及先按段缩放再归约的安全 p 范数。
description_en: Numerical stability of floating point and reductions: compensated and pairwise summation, Welford's online mean and variance, count and sentinel semantics for NaN-skipping reductions, bfloat16 rounding and FP8 block scaling, unbiased versus biased stochastic rounding, sharded online softmax that merges by exchanging only (max, sum), and the safe p-norm that scales each segment before reducing.

name: 上下文压缩合集
description: 推理前把 prompt 压短的三个路数：按词级重要性剪词（LLMLingua-2 用小型分类器判「该删哪个词」）、按文档预算分配（LongLLMLingua 按困惑度给每篇文档算 token 预算、两阶段窗口细裁）、以及预填期一次性裁输入（GemFilter 用早层注意力给输入 token 打分取 top-k）。三题都复现上游的精确打分与选择规则，任何一步换一种「想当然」的实现都会得到另一份结果。
description_en: Three routes to shortening a prompt before inference: word-level importance pruning (LLMLingua-2 uses a small classifier to decide which words to drop), per-document budget allocation (LongLLMLingua assigns token budgets by perplexity and refines with two-stage windows), and one-shot input pruning at prefill (GemFilter scores input tokens with early-layer attention and takes the top-k). All three reproduce the upstream scoring and selection rules exactly; any "obvious" shortcut yields a different answer.

name: 线性注意力与状态空间合集
description: 次二次复杂度序列建模的核心递推账：Mamba 的 selective scan 参考实现（deltaA 指数衰减、deltaB_u 输入注入、D 跳连与 z 门、变体 einsum 与数值精度口径）、Gated DeltaNet 的门控线性递推（状态指数遗忘、误差校正写入 (v−h·k)β、按头 scale 与输出读出）、RWKV v6 的 per-token 逐通道衰减 WKV 递推（(a,b,p) log-space 三元组、bonus 只进输出分支、w 加在旧指数上），以及 Gated Linear Attention 的 chunk 并行恒等式（段内含入 cumsum、段间/段内两支拆分、段末衰减按 key 通道逐行）。
description_en: Core recurrence ledgers of sub-quadratic sequence modeling: Mamba's selective-scan reference implementation (deltaA exponential decay, deltaB_u input injection, the D skip connection and z gate, variant einsums and numerical-precision conventions), the gated linear recurrence of Gated DeltaNet (exponential state forgetting, the error-correcting write (v−h·k)β, per-head scale and the output read), RWKV v6's per-token per-channel-decay WKV recurrence ((a,b,p) log-space triplet, bonus only in the output branch, w applied to the old exponent), and Gated Linear Attention's chunked-parallel identity (inclusive in-chunk cumsum, inter/intra split, end-of-chunk decay applied row-wise per key channel).

name: 可解释性合集
description: 打开模型内部的两把扳手加一读一写：稀疏自编码器的 TopK 重构账（减 b_dec 后编码、top-k 不做 ReLU、解码重构与 l0 / mse / max_feat 三项指标）、tuned lens 的逐层仿射探针（W_l h_l + b_l 直读 final logits、按层 CE 与 KL(p_final‖p_layer)、float64 稳定计算）、logit lens 的免训练读出账（中间隐态过 final LayerNorm + unembed、argmax 并列取小、agree 与 rank_of_final 排名账），以及 activation steering 的注入账（同层累加、normalize 语义、cos_before/after 与 proj_coef 正交化账）。
description_en: Two wrenches plus a read and a write for opening up a model: the TopK sparse-autoencoder reconstruction ledger (encode after subtracting b_dec, top-k without ReLU, decoded reconstruction with l0 / mse / max_feat metrics), tuned-lens per-layer affine probes (W_l h_l + b_l reading straight into final logits, per-layer CE and KL(p_final‖p_layer), float64-stable computation), the training-free logit-lens readout ledger (intermediate states through the final LayerNorm + unembed, argmax ties to smallest index, agree and rank_of_final accounting), and the activation-steering injection ledger (same-layer accumulation, normalize semantics, cos_before/after and the proj_coef orthogonalization account).

name: 推理系统合集
description: 推理期把 N 份候选折成一个答案、再把预算折成行为的确定性账本：self-consistency 的答案归一化与加权计票（8 条钉死的归一化规则、首次出现序票仓、并列取先者）、PRM best-of-N 的步级聚合（last / max / min / product 四种口径、answer_scores 乘项、并列取小 index 的 top-m 排序）、s1 budget forcing 的三段状态机（步级截断触发 length forcing、Wait 续跑扣预算、回答按剩余截断），以及 overthinking 指标账（答对/答错平均 token 数与效率比、准确率-长度分箱、best_bin 并列取小）。
description_en: Deterministic ledgers that fold N candidates into one answer and a budget into behavior at inference time: self-consistency answer normalization and weighted voting (8 pinned normalization rules, first-occurrence-order tallies, ties to the earliest), PRM best-of-N step aggregation (the last / max / min / product rules, the answer_scores multiplier, top-m ranking with ties to the smaller index), the s1 budget-forcing three-phase state machine (step truncation triggering length forcing, Wait extensions consuming budget, the answer truncated by the remainder), and the overthinking metric ledger (mean tokens of correct vs wrong answers with the efficiency ratio, accuracy-length binning, best_bin with ties to the smallest).

name: OCR 与文档解析合集
description: OCR 与文档解析的可转写机制：识别头 CTC greedy 解码与 blank 分隔 collapse、文档 bbox 归一化与 2D 位置索引、评测侧逐行归一化编辑距离账、整页截图的可变宽高比 patch 网格预算、表格结构 token 的 cell 网格展开、llama.cpp mtmd 的多模态批调度、PP-Structure 双栏阅读顺序状态机、olmOCR 图片元素 union-find 容差合并等纯账本（真图/编码器不出，坐标、矩阵与字符串全入参）。 PaddleOCR DB 后处理单框账：box_score_fast 的 bbox floor/ceil/clip 与 fillPoly 坐标 astype 向零截断两套口径共存（闭矩形含右下边界、全零 mask 均值 0.0）、unclip 距离 = |shoelace|×ratio/闭合周长、pyclipper 输入截断/输出 round-half-away 的整数语义、min_size 与 min_size+2 双尺寸门与门序、dest 缩放银行家舍入与双界 clip。 DeepSeek-OCR 五档动态分辨率与 tile 账：小图门 and 一维越界即切与 <= 恰等、ratio 集合 i/j 上界是循环变量 n 的构造 quirk、最近匹配严格 < 先到先得与 diff 平分的 area 抢位（阈值随 tile 数增大）、resize 直接拉伸非等比与行优先 tile box、token 序列账全局 (qb+1)·qb+1 与局部 (q·nw+1)·q·nh（行内跨 tile 连排共享行末 sep）及与 README 编码器口径的差异。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from OCR and document parsing: the recognition head's CTC greedy decoding with blank-separator collapse, document bbox normalization and 2D position indexing, per-line normalized edit distance metrics, the variable aspect-ratio patch grid budget for full-page screenshots, table structure token cell-grid expansion, llama.cpp mtmd multimodal batch scheduling, the PP-Structure two-column reading-order state machine, and olmOCR's union-find image-element tolerance merging, as pure ledgers (no real images or encoders; coordinates, matrices and strings are explicit inputs). The PaddleOCR DB postprocess single-box ledger: box_score_fast's floor/ceil/clip bbox coexisting with fillPoly's truncate-toward-zero rasterization (closed rectangle including right/bottom edges, all-zero mask mean of 0.0), the unclip distance of |shoelace|×ratio over the closed perimeter, pyclipper's integer semantics of truncated inputs and round-half-away outputs, the min_size and min_size+2 size gates with their ordering, and dest rescaling's banker's rounding with two-sided clipping. The DeepSeek-OCR five-mode dynamic resolution and tile ledger: the small-image and-gate where a single overflowing dimension triggers tiling and <= passes exactly at the bound, the ratio-set quirk whose i/j bound is the loop variable n, the closest match's strict < first-come-first-served with area stealing on diff ties (the threshold growing with tile count), direct non-aspect-preserving resize with row-major tile boxes, and the token sequence ledger of global (qb+1)·qb+1 plus local (q·nw+1)·q·nh (tiles sharing a row-end sep) versus the README's pure-encoder accounting.

name: 语音识别合集
description: 语音识别系统的可转写机制：CTC greedy 解码、声学谱增强段掩蔽、CIF integrate-and-fire 发射状态机、Whisper 30s 窗口 seek 推进等纯账本（真音频/编码器不出，谱、权重与 token 流全入参）。 WhisperX 强制对齐账：trellis DP 的列 0 尾部 +inf 强制收尾填充、回溯严格大于的平分留 blank 与两域混用（log 域 DP + 概率域帧分）、merge_repeats 帧均与 merge_words 长度加权两套聚合、separator 三态不产空词、T<N 必返 None 的不变量。 Whisper 语言 ID 账：非语言位 -inf 抑制后 softmax 的语言集合重归一化（raw 对照）、argmax 与 max(probs) 两套平分规则、单条/批双路解包、transcribe 只跑首个 30s 窗的检测策略与显式 language 跳过。 FunASR FSMN-VAD 端点检测决策核账：帧判定的概率门/SNR 门双门与噪声 EMA 窄更新面（门失败不更新、跨段延续）、滑窗状态机环形未满不遗忘与双阈值翻转、thresh=max_end_silence-speech_to_sil 相减 quirk、起点回退与终点回退 54 帧、假段与 single 终态跳帧、max_time_out 仅 Speech2Speech 置位。 NeMo TDT token-and-duration 贪心解码账：blank 的 duration 强制 ≥1 与非 blank 同样按 duration 跳帧的 TDT/RNN-T 本质差异（跳出句末发射仍有效）、发射时间戳在跳帧前快照、max_symbols 强制 blank 只进 1 帧忽略 duration、非 blank duration=0 的域约束与官方无防护。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from speech recognition: CTC greedy decoding, spectral augmentation band masking, the CIF integrate-and-fire emission state machine, and Whisper's 30s window seek loop, as pure ledgers (no real audio or encoders; spectrograms, weights and token streams are explicit inputs). The WhisperX forced-alignment ledger: the column-0 tail +inf forced-completion fill, strict-greater backtracking ties that stay on blank with mixed log/probability domains, the frame-mean versus length-weighted two-aggregator split between merge_repeats and merge_words, separator three-state empty-word guards, and the ok-equals-(T>=N) invariant. The Whisper language-ID ledger: post-suppression softmax renormalization over the language set (with the raw control), the two disagreeing tie rules of argmax and max(probs), single/batch dual-path unwrapping, and the transcribe policy of detecting only on the first 30s window with explicit-language skip. The FunASR FSMN-VAD endpoint decision-core ledger: the probability/SNR dual gate with the noise EMA's narrow update surface (gate failures leave it untouched, persisting across segments), the sliding-window machine's no-forget-while-unfilled ring and dual-threshold flips, the max_end_silence-speech_to_sil subtraction quirk, 54-frame start/end lookbacks, fake segments and single-mode terminal skipping, and max_time_out set only in the Speech2Speech branch. The NeMo TDT token-and-duration greedy decoding ledger: blank's forced duration >= 1 versus non-blanks skipping frames by duration as the essential TDT/RNN-T difference (an emission that jumps past the end still counts), emission timestamps snapshotted before the jump, max_symbols forced blanks advancing exactly 1 frame and ignoring duration, and the non-blank zero-duration domain constraint where the official code has no protection.

name: 语音合成合集
description: TTS 系统的可转写机制：FastSpeech2 方差适配器时长链与展开账、中文 TN 数字读法规引擎等纯账本（真音频/声学模型不出，predictor 输出与规则串全入参）。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from TTS systems: the FastSpeech2 variance adaptor duration chain and expansion ledger, and the Chinese TN number verbalization rule engine, as pure ledgers (no real audio or acoustic models; predictor outputs and rule strings are explicit inputs).

name: 全模态合集
description: 全栈语音-文本模型的可转写机制：Thinker-Talker 隐态逐帧回灌与 1:1 配比、语音-文本交错流的渐进分块解析、Moshi 双流 acoustic delay 与覆盖链等纯账本（真模型不出，隐态与 token 流全入参）。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from full-duplex speech-text models: the thinker-talker frame-by-frame hidden-state replay at a 1:1 ratio, progressive chunking of interleaved speech-text streams, and Moshi's dual-stream acoustic delay with its overwrite chain, as pure ledgers (no real models; hidden states and token streams are explicit inputs).
